definitionsZh: adv. 戏剧地, 引人注目地, 突然地

definitionsEn: a. characterized by or advocating or based upon the principles of democracy or social equality
a. belong to or relating to the Democratic Party
s. representing or appealing to or adapted for the benefit of the people at large
definitionsZh: [法] 民主的, 民主政体的, 平民的

example.en: Taiwan is a democratic country.
example.zh: 台灣是一個民主國家。

definitionsEn: n. the condition or result of being changeable
The quality of being diverse or different; a difference or unlikeness.
A variety; diverse types or examples.

phrases.translationZh: 生物多类状态, 生物差异

definitionsEn: n. something of little value
s. used as expletives
definitionsZh: n. 一点, 诅咒, 丝毫
vt. 诅咒, 罚...下地狱

example.en: The president said, "I don't give a damn."
example.zh: 总统说，我才不屌呢。

definitionsEn: s. (often followed by `from') not alike
different in nature or quality
a. easy to perceive
definitionsZh: a. 清楚的, 显著的, 不同的

example.zh: 这完全是两个不同的观点。

n. an event (or the result of an event) that completely destroys something
The act of destroying.

phrases.translationZh: [法] 意外毁损, 事故毁损

example.zh: 核戰爭將會為人類帶來滅亡。

definitionsEn: r. in another and different manner;

example.zh: 神平等造人而人心各异。

n. the quality of being determined to do or achieve something
firmness of purpose

example.zh: 他下定了決心要做醫生。

definitionsEn: a. separated in space or coming from or going to a distance
a. far apart in relevance or relationship or kinship
s. separate or apart in time

example.zh: 我們看到了遠方燈塔的微光。

example.zh: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。

definitionsEn: n. the amount per unit size
The amount of a certain phenomenon (such as stuff, things, energy, or otherwise) in a given area (surface area) or volume (amount of space).

[计] 受主浓度, 受主密度

example.en: Japan has a high population density.
example.zh: 日本的人口密度很高。
